module.name: Stingy Scanner by Digizaal
module.description: Reputation scanner for every website on your Plesk server, and a helper to win a site's good name back after an attack. Checks every hosted site (and external sites you add) with VirusTotal, Google Safe Browsing and AVG/Avast for malware, phishing and spam, without burning your daily API quota. When a site is flagged: scan its files with ClamAV, Maldet or Imunify and clean or quarantine them, find rogue WordPress admins, see which administrator e-mail addresses are pwned in known data breaches (Pwned? overview, XposedOrNot or Have I Been Pwned), and ask every vendor that still flags the site for a review, with the full history of the site. Built by Digizaal, an Amsterdam web agency hosting 600+ websites on Plesk.
